For duration-based exercises, total accumulated time across all sets in a session or time window. Used to chart consistency and gradual increases for holds or mobility work.

description: iOS Health permission sheet: NSHealthShareUsageDescription. Native InfoPlist.strings and the English plist fallback are generated on translation import.
en: Heart shows your resting heart rate, sleep and body data alongside your training, so you can see how they move together. This data stays on your device — Heart never uploads it.
en_CA: Heart shows your resting heart rate, sleep and body data alongside your training, so you can see how they move together. This data stays on your device — Heart never uploads it.
ru: Heart показывает пульс в покое, сон и данные о теле рядом с тренировками, чтобы вы могли видеть, как они связаны. Эти данные остаются на вашем устройстве — Heart никогда их не отправляет на сервер.

en: Heart saves each workout you finish to the Health app, so your rings credit your lifting. It writes how long you trained and that it was strength training — nothing else, and nothing leaves your device.
en_CA: Heart saves each workout you finish to the Health app, so your rings credit your lifting. It writes how long you trained and that it was strength training — nothing else, and nothing leaves your device.

es: Heart guarda cada entrenamiento que terminas en la app Salud para que tus sesiones de fuerza cuenten para tus anillos de actividad. Solo registra cuánto tiempo has entrenado y que fue un entrenamiento de fuerza. Nada más, y ningún dato sale de tu dispositivo.

description: Help tooltip on the muscle map's list: how sets are counted per muscle group
en: Completed sets per muscle group in the chosen period. A set counts in full for the muscles an exercise mainly works and as half for the ones it also works: one set of bench press adds 1 to Chest and ½ to Arms. An exercise you made counts in full toward its body part.
en_CA: Completed sets per muscle group in the chosen period. A set counts in full for the muscles an exercise mainly works and as half for the ones it also works: one set of bench press adds 1 to Chest and ½ to Arms. An exercise you made counts in full toward its body part.

es: Series completadas por grupo muscular en el periodo elegido. Una serie cuenta entera para los músculos que el ejercicio trabaja principalmente y media para los que también trabaja: una serie de press de banca suma 1 a Pecho y ½ a Brazos. Un ejercicio creado por ti cuenta entero para su parte del cuerpo.

Une série compte entièrement pour les muscles que l’exercice travaille surtout et pour moitié pour ceux qu’il sollicite aussi : une série de développé couché ajoute 1 aux Pectoraux et ½ aux Bras. Un exercice que vous avez créé compte entièrement pour sa partie du corps.

en:
From another account or another phone? Bring your Heart history along.

In Heart, go to Settings → Export my data and save either file, then pick it here. The JSON brings everything back: workouts, templates and folders, custom exercises and goals. The CSV brings workouts and their sets only.

¿Desde otra cuenta u otro teléfono? Trae tu historial de Heart contigo.

En Heart, ve a Ajustes → Exportar mis datos, guarda cualquiera de los dos archivos y elígelo aquí. El JSON lo trae todo: entrenamientos, plantillas y carpetas, ejercicios propios y objetivos. El CSV, solo los entrenamientos y sus series.
